use default

padovan(step: int, count: int) -> LIST[int] is
    let terms mut = LIST()

    if step == 2 then
        terms.add(1)
        terms.add(1)
        terms.add(1)
    else
        terms = LIST(padovan(step - 1, count)[0::step])
    fi

    while terms.count < count do
        let total mut = 0

        for back in 2::step + 1 do
            total = total + terms[terms.count - back]
        od

        terms.add(total)
    od

    terms
si

for step in 2::8 do
    let terms = padovan(step, 15) |> map(term => "{term,4}")

    write_line("{step}:{terms |> join("")}")
od
